interface.longDescription:
B2B Market & Lead Intelligence packages 15 portable SKILL.md playbooks, n8n/Make.com automation blueprints, Python AI agent examples, and remote MCP endpoints for market research, RAG ingestion, and outbound lead generation.

Zero-Key Pipelines (No API Key Required):
- Google News CBMi/AU_yqL wrapper URL decoding to canonical publisher URLs (via companion b2b-market-intel-mcp STDIO server and Python examples).
- UK Contracts Finder OCDS live public tenders and .gov.uk buyer contact previews.
- ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 recruiting Industry Biotech/Pharma studies and sponsor contacts.
- Public REST signal workflows for WordPress.org Plugins 1.2 and Atlassian Marketplace REST v2.

Optional APIFY_TOKEN Cloud Batch Scrapers (mcp.apify.com):
- Connect your own APIFY_TOKEN (new Apify accounts include $5/month free credit) for full-scale batch extraction across Google News RAG full-article text, Reed UK direct-employer jobs (with IR35 & agency filtering), Seek AU/NZ GraphQL hiring signals, unified iOS App Store + Google Play 1-star churn reviews, and Google Ads Transparency Center creatives & EU DSA reach.

All tools are read-only and designed for structured agent consumption with concise agentSummary outputs.
defaultPrompt: Decode a Google News RSS article link to its real publisher URL and extract clean RAG-ready summary fields.
Find UK direct-employer software jobs or live UK Gov Contracts Finder tenders with buyer contacts.
Analyze 1-star and 2-star churn reviews for a competitor iOS, Android, or Shopify app to uncover recurring bugs.
